node.title: Primitive two-petal cofactors give an aggregate core/background distance bound
node.statement: For two distinct exact rate-half M=4,t=2 contributors in one fixed source, touched pair, and defect parameter d=ell+s, the primitive cofactor determinant A_1A'_2-A'_1A_2 is nonzero of degree at most 2s and vanishes on every shared missed-core and shared background-agreement point. Hence the combined overlap is at most 2s. The combined supports have size at least ell+2s, yielding the aggregate bound floor(binom(k-1+b,2s+1)/binom(ell+2s,2s+1)) without enumerating background sets. Its exponent grows with s, so no uniform polynomial payment is claimed.
